name: ANSI/IEEE three-phase ac motor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for three-phase ac motor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The three-phase motor form identifies a load connected to a documented three-phase circuit. Star/delta links, starter and overload information are separate details that should be linked rather than inferred from the machine representation.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Distinguish simplified load indication from an expanded winding connection.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Three-phase representation does not by itself establish a star or delta connection.
